title: plugin-security: under the walled posture, deployment-level audience-binding acceptance is host configuration (ADR-0131 D5) — the sync stops warning once declared; the refusal names that path, not "create the Default Organization" (cloud#2872 A′)
body:
Filing gate ③: a question left by a ruling. Ruling A′ on objectstack-ai/cloud#2872 (6160165869, maintainer 「同意」, 2026-10-14) names this as the framework's follow-up, item 3. Filed by the director seat (summon #37, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB`) under 「立卡你决定，不需要我同意」. ⛔ Not a claim; grading and routing are triage's (p3 proposed: zero pull today, the cost is one non-fatal warn per boot and a 409 at a door nobody needs yet).

`reach:` a walled (multi-organization) deployment with no organization of slug `default`: objectstack-ai/cloud's control plane on both planes (the audit cloud#2872 6159344518: 48 and 12 organizations, no `default`). Measured there by the cloud seat's reading of this code; the warn is non-fatal.

## Governing text

- ADR-0131 D5: "Platform standing is configuration, or a Default-Organization row under `single`" — "`PLATFORM_ADMIN` derives from `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` … configuration, not a row … under a walled posture no grant row is written".
- ADR-0131 §1.5 "The rejected middle: a platform organization": a reserved organization for deployment-level rows "adds a concept every organization enumerator must special-case, and exists only to give NULL a new name".
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/suggested-audience-bindings.ts:88–92` (`NO_RECORD_OWNER_MESSAGE`): "owned by the Default Organization (ADR-0131 D3/D5), and this deployment has none … Remedy: create the Default Organization (slug 'default')". The remedy prescribes §1.5's rejected shape for a walled deployment.

## What happens (on `main` `713f23185`)

- `resolveDefaultOrganizationId` (`:427–436`): slug `default`, else the only organization, else `undefined`.
- `readAcceptedEveryoneSets` (`:493–494`): no owner ⇒ the accepted list is empty; `everyone` = the baseline alone. The sync throws `SuggestionStateError(NO_RECORD_OWNER_MESSAGE)` (`:622`, `:777`); `security-plugin.ts:4490` and `:4587` log `[security] audience-binding suggestion sync failed (non-fatal)` and boot continues; the acceptance door answers 409 `SUGGESTION_STATE`.
- So a walled host that has nothing to confirm (cloud: its only declared default is its own baseline) gets a warn at every boot and a remedy it must not follow.

## What to build (measure first; the dev reads the module's doc and the `single`-posture tests before changing anything)

1. A host declaration for the walled posture, on the security plugin's options (the dev names it under the spec's shape rules; the shape is a closed list of accepted deployment-level permission-set names, possibly empty): under the walled posture with no `default` organization, `readAcceptedEveryoneSets` reads the declared list; the sync does not run against a record owner (or runs silently); the suggestion rows per organization are reported once, as today.
2. The refusal under the walled posture names the configuration path (the option's name), not "create the Default Organization"; the `single` posture keeps D5's Default-Organization row and its message.
3. ADR-0131 gains one amendment line (Tier H, the maintainer's hand) recording the walled posture's configuration path for deployment-level acceptance.
- ⛔ No NULL-`organization_id` row anywhere (the record's title); ⛔ no change to the `single` posture; ⛔ no new table.

## Acceptance

- A walled boot with no `default` organization and a declared empty list: no warn, `everyone` = baseline, the acceptance door answers a located refusal naming the option; with a declared set: that set is granted through `everyone`; a walled boot with no declaration: today's behaviour, with the new message. The `single` posture's suggestion tests unchanged and green.
- cloud adopts at a later pin and drops the boot-log warn check ruling A′ added to cloud#2709.

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#2872 (ruling A′ 6160165869) · cloud#2879 (closed as its duplicate) · cloud#2876 (the ADR-0023 sentence) · ADR-0131 D3/D5/§1.5.
